payload.reason: Weekly sync 2026-10-13: agreed to move SMS reminders to Sinch; Vonage is out.
payload.name: Decision - SMS reminder provider is Sinch (effective 2026-11-01)
payload.body:
Decision: Move SMS reminders from Vonage to Sinch.

Effective date: 2026-11-01.

Why: Vonage failed on Portuguese numbers in production; Sinch will be used for SMS reminders going forward.

Decided at weekly sync 2026-10-13 by Maya Okafor, Tom Lindqvist, Priya Raman, Daniel Reyes, Sofia Marchetti, Kenji Watanabe.

payload.note: Sinch replaces previous decision to use Vonage (weekly sync 2026-10-13).

payload.reason: Message from Tom Lindqvist 2026-10-14: agreed to switch product analytics to PostHog Cloud (EU).
payload.name: Decision - Product analytics vendor is PostHog Cloud (EU region)
payload.body:
Decision: Move product analytics to PostHog Cloud (EU region) instead of self-hosting PostHog.

Why: Self-hosting PostHog is consuming too much ops time; PostHog Cloud (EU) keeps clinic data in the EU while reducing ops burden.

Decided: Tom Lindqvist and Maya Okafor (message 2026-10-14).

payload.note: PostHog Cloud (EU) replaces prior decision to self-host PostHog (Tom message 2026-10-14).

payload.reason: Message from Daniel Reyes 2026-10-15: agreed to switch to twice-weekly releases (Tues & Thurs).
payload.name: Decision - Release cadence is twice-weekly (Tuesdays & Thursdays) behind feature flags
payload.body:
Decision: Ship releases twice-weekly on Tuesdays and Thursdays, remaining behind feature flags.

Why: Continuous deploys were surprising pilot clinics; change agreed with Tom Lindqvist and Daniel Reyes (message 2026-10-15).

Effective immediately.

payload.note: Twice-weekly release cadence replaces prior decision to use continuous deploys behind feature flags (decision 316a7a9).

payload.reason: Message from Maya Okafor 2026-10-16: Priya and Kenji agreed to replace Tailwind UI kit with shadcn/ui.
payload.name: Decision - Design system is shadcn/ui (replaces Tailwind UI kit)
payload.body:
Decision: Adopt shadcn/ui as the design system, replacing the Tailwind UI kit.

Who agreed: Priya Raman and Kenji Watanabe (message from Maya Okafor 2026-10-16).

Why: Agreed replacement of UI kit for consistency with component-based library.

payload.note: shadcn/ui replaces earlier decision to use Tailwind UI kit (Priya & Kenji agreed 2026-10-16).
